items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Battery storage is building a second floor of demand, and Western reshoring gives established domestic producers like Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) outsized leverage. Benchmark says demand from stationary storage has grown more than 60% a year over the past two years.

items.headline: Fitch Upgrades Albemarle Corporation's Ratings to 'BBB'; Outlook Stable
items.snippet: High-Quality Lithium Assets: Albemarle's lithium asset base includes high-grade, long-life brine and spodumene resources that support a favorable cost position, moderate input risk and enhance resilience through lithium-price cycles.

items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Mizuho's updated forecast raised its 2027 lithium demand estimate by almost 10%. Even if storage batteries never drive a car a mile, they may still absorb lithium.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong Battery Energy Storage - BESS - demand has tipped the market balance into a favorable territory.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Supply and demand trends in the lithium market appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO Capital analyst Joel Jackson lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200 and keeps an Outperform rating, citing recent spot price weakness.
